claims.quote: Hoplisoma flaveolum, long known as Corydoras flaveolus, is an armoured catfish from tributaries of the rio Tietê in the upper rio Paraná basin, São Paulo state, Brazil.
Known from several tributary drainages of the rio Tietê which is itself an affluent within the upper rio Paraná basin, São Paulo state, southeastern Brazil.
